title: STTM Session State
description: Schema for output/sttm_session_state.json — persisted state across all STTM plugin commands. Parallel to DE Agent session_state.json but isolated in output/ directory.

workspace_initialized.description: True after /sttm-init successfully creates input/ and output/ directories

python_path.description: Resolved Python executable path (e.g. 'python', 'python3', 'py', or a full path from PYTHON_PATH). Set during /sttm-init Step 4b. Used by /sttm-export (openpyxl) and /sttm-generate (sqlglot, openpyxl). Null if Python not found.

python_version.description: Detected Python version string (e.g. '3.12.7'). Set during /sttm-init Step 4b. Null if Python not found.

output_prefix.description: Computed output file prefix (e.g., 'fdp_uk_mortgage_db_mortgage_account'). Set during Step 1 of /sttm-generate.

target_database.description: Target database name from target schema (e.g., 'fdp_uk_mortgage_db')

target_tables.description: Array of distinct target table names found in target schema

io_mode.description: I/O mode: 'table' (default, all sources/targets are database tables), 'file' (sources and/or target are parquet files), 'hybrid' (mix of file and table sources/targets). Set during Step 4 (CLASSIFY) based on code prescan and interview evidence.

source_io.description: File-based source configuration. Populated when io_mode is 'file' or 'hybrid' and one or more sources are parquet files. Null when all sources are database tables.

logical_name.description: Derived from storage_path basename (last non-empty path segment). Used as pseudo-table name throughout the mapping.

storage_path.description: Absolute storage path from mapping Column H (e.g., 's3://raw-bucket/data/customer_events/' for Glue, '/Volumes/catalog/schema/volume/customer_events/' for Databricks).

schema_mode.description: 'inferred' = schema read from parquet file at runtime. 'explicit' = schema provided in input/source_metadata/{logical_name}_schema.json.

partition_columns.description: Partition columns of the parquet file source (e.g., ['year', 'month']). Used for filter pushdown.

target_io.description: File-based target configuration. Populated when target_table contains (file:parquet) suffix or io_mode indicates file target. Null when target is a database table.

logical_name.description: Logical name for the file target — stripped from target_table field (e.g., 'customer_events_clean' from 'customer_events_clean (file:parquet)').

format.description: File format for the target output.

write_mode.description: 'overwrite' = full replace on each run (Day0-like). 'append' = add new partition data (Day1-like).

partition_by.description: Columns to partition the output parquet by (e.g., ['dw_bus_dt']).

is_shared_data_product.description: True if target database uses shared_ prefix. Classification still resolves to parent type (FDP/CDP/BDP).

io_mode.description: 4th axis: physical I/O mode for sources and target

step_2_interview_pass_metadata.description: Tracks interview pass progress for resume support. Null if interview not started.

current_pass.description: Pass currently in progress. Null between passes or before start.

current_pass_next_question_id.description: ID of the next question to present on resume (e.g. '5.13')

current_pass_questions_answered.description: Number of questions answered in the current pass so far

validation_result.description: Latest validation check results from Step 7 or /sttm-validate

output_files.description: Paths to generated output files (populated during Step 8 EXPORT)

data_flow_detection.description: Multi-source-system detection and artifact mode. Populated during Step 1 (INGEST) when multiple data flows are detected. Used by downstream code generation commands (/gen-config, /gen-transform, etc.) to determine per-source-system artifact generation strategy.

resolved_mode.description: Detected data flow mode from 3-way priority (user override → domain knowledge → mapping structure → default)

resolved_by.description: Which detection priority resolved the data flow mode

artifact_mode.description: Artifact generation strategy: 'default' (single-flow or per-source-system when source_systems is non-empty), 'combined' (single artifact with UNION logic)

source_systems.description: List of source_system labels (e.g., ['ilp', 'reference_data']). Populated when resolved_mode is 'multiple_data_flow'. When non-empty, commands loop per source_system to generate independent artifacts.

source_system_table_mapping.description: Maps each source_system label to its source tables (FQN). Built from mapping_parsed.json source_system_hint. Example: {"ilp": ["e_cms_db.cmrcase"], "reference_data": ["ref_common_db.region_lookup"]}

union_detected.description: True when mapping Business Logic contains 'Union Branch N:' structured format or union_metadata is present
